name: AMD Helios pod (4 racks + 2 network racks)
description: Four amd-helios racks (288 MI455X GPUs, 4 separate 72-GPU UALoE scale-up domains) in a row with one network-rack holding scale-out leaf switches. In 0.6 m slot units, each double-wide Helios takes 2 slots (offsets 0, 2, 4, 6) and the network rack sits at slot 8.
notes: The pod size is an assumption. AMD publishes no pod grouping for Helios: the scale-up domain is one rack, and racks join only over the Ethernet scale-out fabric. The Schneider/AMD reference design sizes clusters by MW (up to 10.4 MW), not by a fixed rack count. Four racks were chosen as a convenient row unit of about 1 MW (4 x 246 kW planning peak). Scale-out links are not listed here: the twin's network solver derives them from each rack's scale_out_ports (216 x 800G per Helios with 3 Vulcano NICs per GPU) and routes them. Two network racks are included because 864 leaf-facing 800G ports exceed one network rack: at 1:1 oversubscription a 144-port leaf has 72 downlinks, so 864 ports need 12 leaves, and the catalog network rack holds 8 switches (estimated). Front-end (18 Salina 400G DPUs per rack) and management links are not counted.
